name: PubMed via NCBI E-utilities
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine / National Center for Biotechnology Information
accessNotes: Panacea retrieves PubMed identifiers and citation metadata through its server-side NCBI E-utilities adapter. Optional NCBI_API_KEY only changes rate limits.
notes: PubMed indexing establishes bibliographic provenance, not study quality, guideline status, causality, or individual clinical applicability. Article full-text rights remain separate from citation metadata.
